scope: Complete per-glyph Korean dictionary order, direction, boundary and form crosscheck. Not exam-body certification.

entries.notes: 扌 three and the 人 and bar of 兪 (4-6) match, but the dictionary writes the lower left of 兪 as 月 with two inner dots and the right as 巜 (two folds, 9-10) where the licensed MM original draws 俞 with inner bars and 刂 (a short vertical and a hooked vertical). The probe flags 9 and 10 because the dictionary folds cannot be derived from the MM verticals. Order and direction cannot bridge the form difference, so the glyph is held, as 瑜 was

疒 five and the 人 and bar of 兪 (6-8) match, but the dictionary writes the lower left of 兪 as 月 with two inner dots and the right as 巜 (two folds, 15-16) where the licensed MM original draws 俞 with inner bars and 刂. Order and direction cannot bridge the form difference, so the glyph is held, as 瑜 was; the 疒 dot leans in MM by 57°, below the inspection threshold, and would otherwise be kept

Order and direction cannot bridge the form difference, so the glyph is held, as 瑜 was
